objective: Compare natural default/v1/v2 candidate selection and same-cache-path candidate rankings after the qualified descriptor setup fix.

flashinfer_source.implementation: Exact original diff applied cleanly to0.7.2, not full PR head; candidate source only for every arm.
flashinfer_source.native_loading: Reuse audited prepare_native(candidate): explicit JitSpec.build/load, identical module bootstrap in every arm; reject AOT substitution. One isolated candidate build workspace, fresh process/container per worker.

execution_commit_rule: Freeze and push clean source including plan, worker and analyzer before GPU launch. Record exact Git SHA, source hashes, input manifest and native build hashes; preserve every failed attempt.

environment.hardware_change: Original H10080GBHBM3 host ipp2-0037 is occupied. All new comparisons use one exclusive H100NVL host with the same580.159.04driver and pinned image; do not compare absolute timings against earlier HBM3 batches.

workload.inputs: Fixed seeded FP8 e4m3fn bytes and unit FP32 scales, BF16 output; identical data across arms for each shape/seed.
workload.persistence: Actual SGLang startup wrapper with existing v1 JSON, managed stores disabled

arms.default: Disable both tuning contexts within the real wrapper; preserve startup/load/save/streams; bare serving is a true uncached -1 miss.
arms.v1: Null only v2 context; retain original v1 candidate selection and persistence.
arms.v2: Unmodified current wrapper with nested v2 selection and existing v1 persistence.

workload.m144_scope: Startup and serving both use144; candidate enumeration uses canonical bucket256. This does not independently test a separate tune256-to-serve144 transfer.

protocol.oracle_order: Seeded shuffle of default -1 and all runtime-enumerated descriptors, recorded per worker.
protocol.lookup_tiers: Natural cold tuned winner uses real memory cache; natural fresh warm tuned winner remains in v1 file configs (no promotion). Oracle follows that same tier using actual memory entries or unique real save/load files. Untuned natural default miss is a separate end-to-end control; seeded oracle default is explicitly labeled.
protocol.primary_instrumentation: No native preload, choose/search/binding hooks or profiler in timing windows. Profiling attempt guard remains installed but cannot execute outside cold startup.
protocol.checkpoint: Run M128 first, copy closed caches and analyze all18 workers before starting M144. Correctness/provenance/completeness determine acceptance, not a required v2 speedup.
protocol.startup_intervals: Diagnostic only: explicit native build/load and initial public API preparation are excluded; actual tuning candidate enumeration/profiling inside the wrapper is included. No complete-server startup claim.

acceptance: Exact pinned image/GPU/source/native hashes and distinct fresh container IDs match.
All attempted profiles are counted before exceptions; zero default/warm/post-startup attempts, including caught exceptions.
Natural tuned choices are genuine hits, remain identical after context exit/capture/restart, and persist with unchanged cache bytes.
Finite default -1 runtime-bucket profiling participates in v2 and is absent from v1. Natural profiled winner matches actual profiling minimum; do not require -1 to win.
Native actual descriptor-use is1 for accepted explicit tactics. Preserve rejected candidate reasons, never treat heuristic fallback as execution of the requested descriptor.
Independent rankings use matched lookup tiers with actual save/load on warm oracle; original natural cache bytes/state are restored.
Eager numerical checks and poisoned/changed/restored-input CUDA Graph replay checks pass for every measured natural and accepted oracle tactic.
Calibrated positive timing samples and exact normalization/medians pass. Record neutral outcomes and failures without selective exclusions.
analysis: Use three paired trial ratios of fresh-worker medians per shape, phase and execution mode; within-worker samples are not independent trials.
Compare natural v2/v1 and tuned/default outcomes; report actual choices, runtime profile times, all candidates, accepted/excluded pools, cache tiers and input identities.
Selected-versus-best regret uses the selected tactic measurement within the same accepted oracle sweep; natural-versus-oracle timing is a separately labeled cross-window diagnostic.
Replicate the residual eager explicit/default gap before optimizing it; no policy change or universal v2/serving claim.
One operation on one H100; no full model, distributed, BF16 or managed-store qualification.
Hardware changed to H100NVL for availability. All arms in this batch share that exact GPU/host/driver; earlier HBM3 absolute timings are separate evidence.

publication.record: Preserve raw JSON/logs/cache bytes and source/build provenance in checksummed archives, machine-readable analysis and the existing single Markdown working record.
